description: Code, per-seed result records (JSON), cached CFD runs and scripts that regenerate every table, figure and quoted number of the accompanying papers. The records and the CFD runs are packed in results/records.zip and results/cfd_runs.zip; unpack them with python experiments/results_pack.py. See README.md and docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md.
